description: Function taxonomy of the site: each reusable core in data/cores.json lists one or more of these ids; catalogue_tags map to data/catalogue.json functions tags.

functions.title: HDMI / DVI output
functions.description: TMDS encoders, serializers and DVI/HDMI transmitters (with or without audio), for the GPDI port.

functions.title: VGA and video timing
functions.description: VGA timing generators, framebuffers and text modes; 6845 CRTC, scandoublers.

functions.title: Composite video (CVBS)
functions.description: PAL/NTSC composite video generation.

functions.title: SPI OLED / LCD displays
functions.description: Drivers for ST7789, SSD1331, SSD1351, SSD1306 and similar small SPI displays.

functions.title: ESP32 OSD and loading
functions.description: On-screen display and ROM/disk loading driven by the ULX3S ESP32 over SPI.

functions.title: Camera input
functions.description: Camera sensor capture (OV7670 etc.) and video input.

functions.title: SDRAM controllers
functions.description: SDR SDRAM controllers (the ULX3S has 32 MB SDR SDRAM).

functions.title: DDR3 memory
functions.description: DDR3 controllers and PHYs for ECP5 boards that have DDR3.

functions.title: PSRAM and HyperRAM
functions.description: QSPI/QPI PSRAM and HyperBus controllers (add-on memories).

functions.title: SD card
functions.description: SD card controllers (SPI mode, SDIO) and FAT helpers.

functions.title: SPI flash
functions.description: SPI/QSPI flash readers, XIP controllers and flash writers.

functions.title: UART
functions.description: Serial transmit/receive cores and UART bridges.

functions.title: SPI master / slave
functions.description: Generic SPI master and slave cores.

functions.title: I2C
functions.description: I2C master/slave cores (RTC, HDMI DDC, sensors).

functions.title: USB device
functions.description: USB full-speed device stacks and CDC-ACM serial on the US2 port.

functions.title: USB host
functions.description: USB low/full-speed host (HID keyboards, mice, gamepads).

functions.title: Bootloaders and DFU
functions.description: USB DFU and other FPGA bootloaders, multiboot.

functions.title: Ethernet
functions.description: RMII/RGMII/SGMII MACs and IP/UDP stacks, PTP.

functions.title: PS/2 keyboard and mouse
functions.description: PS/2 keyboard and mouse interfaces.

functions.title: JTAG and debug
functions.description: User JTAG access, debug bridges, logic analysers.

functions.title: Buses and interconnect
functions.description: Wishbone/AXI interconnects, arbiters, bridges.

functions.title: ADC
functions.description: ADC interfaces (onboard MAX11125 and external ADCs).

functions.title: DAC, PWM and sigma-delta
functions.description: Sigma-delta/PWM/PDM DACs and external DAC interfaces.

functions.title: I2S and S/PDIF
functions.description: Digital audio interfaces: I2S, S/PDIF, PDM microphones.

functions.title: Sound chips and synths
functions.description: Sound chip reimplementations (SID, SN76489, AY, YM) and synthesizers.

functions.title: Radio (FM/RDS, SDR)
functions.description: FM/RDS transmitters, SDR receive chains, radio front ends.

functions.title: DSP
functions.description: FFT, CIC/FIR filters, NCOs, CORDIC.

functions.title: RISC-V CPUs and SoCs
functions.description: RISC-V cores and small SoCs.

functions.title: Retro CPUs
functions.description: 6502, Z80, 8080, 68000, 1802 and other classic CPUs.

functions.title: Linux-capable SoCs
functions.description: SoCs that boot Linux.

functions.title: PLLs and clocking
functions.description: ECP5 EHXPLLL wrappers and PLL parameter calculators.

functions.title: LED drivers
functions.description: HUB75 panels, WS2812 strips, LED matrices.

functions.title: Crypto and hashing
functions.description: Hash and cipher cores.
